statistical_analysis.notes: Pentool shows lower variance than Nmap across all tests

key_findings.break_even_point: Pentool matches/exceeds Nmap starting at ~100 ports
key_findings.consistency: Pentool has 10-100x lower standard deviation than Nmap

observations: Pentool is faster than Nmap at all tested port ranges (100-30000 ports)
Best relative performance at 500 ports with 2.01x speedup over Nmap
Performance gap narrows as port count increases but Pentool remains faster
At 10000 ports: Pentool 24.83s vs Nmap 25.17s (1.4% faster)
At 30000 ports: Pentool 73.12s vs Nmap 73.42s (0.4% faster)
Pentool shows significantly lower timing variance (more consistent results)
Multi-agent scalability limited by current pub-sub architecture
recommendations: For production use with multiple agents, implement NATS queue groups
Pentool excels in medium-range scans (100-5000 ports) with 1.1x-2.0x speedup
For large port ranges (10000+), Pentool provides marginal but consistent improvement
Consider workload sharding across agents for better multi-agent utilization
